disputes.description: The packet bundles seven independent free __cdecl helpers with no shared owner object; classified as interface (shared helper entry-point surface) rather than type/global/lifecycle because no single struct or persistent state is evidenced across the packet.

The schema records one signature; it describes the representative primary entry (0x0058803F thread-safe stream read wrapper). The other six functions have their own distinct cdecl signatures, recorded in side_effects/postconditions rather than the single signature object.

Layout objects are per-helper buffers (file_stream, pattern_buffer, destination_buffer), not one shared struct. The this+0x0 byte write in 0x0058815F maps to the destination cursor only on the assumption that v6 starts at a1, which the packet itself flags as unproven.

Classified any_thread from the explicit lock/interlocked usage in 0x00587D02, 0x0058803F and 0x00589901; the pairing of the lock primitives 0x0058C1B1/0x0058C203 around one critical section is inferred from naming, not proven by the packet.
